key.name: auto-arrange
key.description: Arrange Desktop items in columns, in the order set by arrange-order. When disabled, items keep the positions they were moved to.

key.name: arrange-order
key.description: The order auto-arrange places Desktop items in: by name, by type, or by date modified (newest first). Home, Trash and mounts always come first.

key.name: snap-to-grid
key.summary: Snap Desktop items to the grid
key.description: Snap moved and dropped Desktop items to the nearest grid cell. When disabled, items can be placed anywhere.

key.name: click-policy
key.summary: Use single or double click to open Desktop items.
key.description: Use single or double click to open Desktop items.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Size of the individual folder and file icons

key.name: max-thumbnail-size
key.summary: Maximum size of images in MBs to generate thumbnails for.
key.description: Maximum size of images in MBs to generate thumbnails for. Larger images still get a thumbnail when another app has already cached one.

key.name: terminal
key.summary: Terminal to use with Open in Terminal
key.description: Terminal to use with Open in Terminal
